name: River Valley
summary: High-rise living between Orchard and the river — city access without CBD sterility.
body: River Valley and the adjacent Mohamed Sultan / Robertson Quay stretch give you towers, river walks, and Orchard retail within a short hop. Singles and dual-income couples often land here for lifestyle density: gyms, restaurants, and late MRT options. Family floorplans exist in newer developments, but outdoor play space is tower-courtyard rather than landed garden. Noise and construction cycles are part of the deal.
housingMix: Mostly high-rise condominiums; serviced apartments common.
commuteNotes: Fort Canning / Great World / Somerset nearby; walkable to parts of Orchard.
